name: fV-SRN
definition: An interactive rendering method for compressed Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) that uses a volumetric latent grid and a lightweight MLP to achieve real-time frame rates by fusing network evaluation into shared memory.
summary: fV-SRN is an interactive volume rendering method for compressed implicit neural representations that achieves real-time speeds by fusing network evaluation into shared memory to eliminate global memory access.
